facts.fact: keyframe_insert from Python made BEZIER keys although preferences.edit.keyframe_new_interpolation_type was set to 'LINEAR' first; with those eased keys the square passes frame 2 faster than the 1 m per frame average, and the shutter-0.5 smear was longer than with LINEAR keys (keyframe_points[i].interpolation = 'LINEAR')

Cycles motion blur is off in a new file (render.use_motion_blur False, shutter 0.5 frames, position CENTER). Turned on, the 0.2 m square moving 1 m per frame smeared to about its size + shutter x speed (0.2 + 0.5 = 0.7 m at shutter 0.5, 1.2 m at 1.0; the measured extents include the 1.5 px pixel filter, 0.25 m with no blur), centred on where it is at the frame

motion_blur_position moves the shutter interval: START opens it at the frame, so the smear lies ahead of the frame's position (centre +0.25 m at shutter 0.5), END behind it (-0.25 m), CENTER around it
Per object, object.cycles.use_motion_blur = False turns the blur off for that object while the scene's is on
EEVEE reads the same scene.render.use_motion_blur and shutter (scene.eevee.use_motion_blur is gone in 4.5)
